name: I Believe in a Thing Called Love

podcast.body: Featured on their 2003 album *Permission to Land*, this song highlights Justin Hawkins's impressive vocal range, including an A from the fifth octave. "Justin Hawkins in the darkness from the 2003 album Permission to Land. And that's I believe in a thing called love."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song, from The Darkness's 2003 debut album *Permission to Land*, features Justin Hawkins's extensive vocal range, including an A from the fifth octave. The song exemplifies the band's sound and Hawkins's high-belting technique, which he distinguishes from falsetto. "I believe, in a thing called love."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
